def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    counts = {3: 0, 1: 0}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == 2 and p not in seen:
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            top = sum(y == minr for y, x in cells)
            bottom = sum(y == maxr for y, x in cells)

            color = 3 if top == 1 and bottom == 3 else 1

    for color, offset in ((3, 0), (1, 3)):
        for y, x in slots[:counts[color]]:
